properties.content: Question: hiv in women symptoms Answer: Symptoms of HIV in women may vary and may overlap with other conditions. Some common symptoms include: Early Symptoms (within 2-4 weeks):: - Fever - Night sweats - Fatigue - Muscle aches - Headache - Swollen lymph nodes (e.g., in the neck, armpits, groin) - Vaginal yeast infections Late Symptoms (after several months):: - Persistent fatigue - Weight loss - Diarrhea - Nausea and vomiting - Mouth sores - Skin rashes - Irregular periods - Pelvic pain - Bone pain - Opportunistic infections (e.g., pneumonia, tuberculosis, candidiasis) Specific Symptoms in Women:: - Vaginal discharge with a strong odor - Genital herpes outbreaks - Increased risk of cervical cancer - Menstrual changes (e.g., heavier or lighter periods) Note: Some women may not experience any symptoms in the early stages of HIV infection. It is important to get tested if you have engaged in risky behaviors, such as unprotected sex, to detect HIV early on.
properties.formattedContent:
Question: hiv in women symptoms

Answer: 
Symptoms of HIV in women may vary and may overlap with other conditions. Some common symptoms include:
Early Symptoms (within 2-4 weeks)::
- Fever
- Night sweats
- Fatigue
- Muscle aches
- Headache
- Swollen lymph nodes (e.g., in the neck, armpits, groin)
- Vaginal yeast infections
Late Symptoms (after several months)::
- Persistent fatigue
- Weight loss
- Diarrhea
- Nausea and vomiting
- Mouth sores
- Skin rashes
- Irregular periods
- Pelvic pain
- Bone pain
- Opportunistic infections (e.g., pneumonia, tuberculosis, candidiasis)
Specific Symptoms in Women::
- Vaginal discharge with a strong odor
- Genital herpes outbreaks
- Increased risk of cervical cancer
- Menstrual changes (e.g., heavier or lighter periods)
Note: Some women may not experience any symptoms in the early stages of HIV infection. It is important to get tested if you have engaged in risky behaviors, such as unprotected sex, to detect HIV early on.
